title: Roasted Mediterranean Courgette Gratin
description: A flavorful and healthy vegetarian side dish made with roasted courgettes, topped with a light mediterranean sauce and served as a gratin.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the sliced courgettes with 2 tbsp of olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Spread the courgettes on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes or until tender.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tbsp of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the crumbled halloumi cheese and cook until melted.
Add the roasted courgettes to the skillet and toss to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and sprinkle with dried oregano and paprika.
Top with additional grated cheese if desired.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-15 minutes or until golden brown.
